title: The DCF on one page (base case, 10.55% WACC)
source: Team valuation model (data/model/assumptions.json) on Bloomberg FA, DES and consensus data. Base case at 10.55% WACC, 3% terminal growth; share price $152.85

seriesSources.Forecast period: Team model: FY28 to FY32; FY27, the current year, is not counted
seriesSources.Revenue CAGR, FY27–32: Team model: base-case revenue, FY27 consensus to FY32, compound yearly growth
seriesSources.Free-cash-flow margin: Bloomberg FA: average of FY24, FY25, FY26; the margin the DCF uses
seriesSources.PV of FCFs: Team valuation model (data/model/assumptions.json) on Bloomberg FA, DES and consensus data, 10.55% WACC
seriesSources.PV of terminal value: Team valuation model (data/model/assumptions.json) on Bloomberg FA, DES and consensus data, 10.55% WACC, 3% terminal growth
seriesSources.Terminal value share of EV: Team valuation model (data/model/assumptions.json) on Bloomberg FA, DES and consensus data: PV of terminal value ÷ enterprise value
seriesSources.Enterprise value: Team valuation model (data/model/assumptions.json) on Bloomberg FA, DES and consensus data, 10.55% WACC
seriesSources.Net debt: Bloomberg DES, 20 Nov 2026: enterprise value minus market cap (negative = net cash)
seriesSources.Equity value: Team valuation model (data/model/assumptions.json) on Bloomberg FA, DES and consensus data: enterprise value + net cash
seriesSources.Diluted shares: Bloomberg FA quarterly, diluted weighted average shares, Q3 FY27
seriesSources.Implied share price: Team valuation model (data/model/assumptions.json) on Bloomberg FA, DES and consensus data: equity value ÷ diluted shares
seriesSources.Share price: Google Finance, NVDA, 24 Nov 2026 (team input; confirm on pitch morning)
seriesSources.Upside: Team valuation model (data/model/assumptions.json) on Bloomberg FA, DES and consensus data: implied price ÷ share price − 1
